sloka: तयोः पादाभिघाताच्च निमग्ना चाभवन्मही।व्याघूर्णिततरङ्गश्च चुक्षुभे वरुणालयः ।। ६.७६.८३ ।।
transliteration: tayoḥ pādābhighātācca nimagnā cābhavanmahī।vyāghūrṇitataraṅgaśca cukṣubhe varuṇālayaḥ ।। 6.76.83 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva's words of flattering royalty captivated Kumbha's fire of energy, which doubled like fire fed with ghee.
